concerns.text: The 'Phase Mapping to Functional Requirements & Success Criteria' table incorrectly links FR‑007 (task‑complexity metric) and SC‑001 (variance‑complexity correlation) to Phase 1, which only performs clip generation and descriptor extraction. FR‑007 and the correlation analysis belong to Phase 5. This mis‑alignment may cause traceability confusion and violates the traceability expectations of the constitution.
